freshness.limitation: Fresh means snapshot commit and linked raw bytes/modes match; unmapped code and runtime wiring are not proven complete

actual_map.qualification: Canonical map intentionally remains baseline/planned; current candidate source differences remain globally stale. Planner must realign; reviewer did not edit canonical state.

criteria.FR-1: Actual current product-baseline and planned feature-conversation each return exactly one full canonical feature, six usefulness cards, explicit display selection, and unchanged global fields.
criteria.FR-2: Default public CLI stdout matches extracted exact baseline byte for byte; all canonical planning file/history hashes unchanged.
criteria.FR-3: Empty, whitespace, unknown, case-mismatched, prefix and padded IDs exit 2 without stdout/fallback. Actual unconfirmed/stale handoffs retain exit 1.
criteria.FR-4: No-Git synthetic greenfield selection retains code absence. Synthetic fresh confirmed fixture exits 0; changing only unselected evidence with hidden index flag and restored mtime exits 1 and preserves global warning.

limitations: No push, PR, merge, release, installation or canonical state transition performed.
No native model/CLI skill, desktop, ChatGPT/dot or customer adoption acceptance established.
Independent review is trusted-source scratch workspace/process isolation, not a security sandbox or authenticated human acceptance.
verdict: FR-1 through FR-4 pass for source/local CLI; no correctness findings
